items.title: Trump's North Carolina rally pinned: Greenville, Tue Oct 20 (official RNC listing)
items.summary: The RNC's official events page and the Greenville Daily Reflector (Oct 13) put Trump's North Carolina midterm rally in Greenville on Tuesday, Oct 20 — doors 3:30 PM, program 5:30 PM, remarks 7 PM ET — correcting the earlier KRPS report that had it on Wednesday Oct 21. Fifth Trump visit to Greenville; tickets up to 4 per signup via the RNC. The stop backs GOP Senate nominee Michael Whatley, who trails Roy Cooper by 14 in the latest poll.
items.source_name: Greenville Daily Reflector (battleground local press) + RNC official events page

items.title: North Carolina early voting down ~19% vs 2022, with Democratic share falling
items.summary: The John Locke Foundation's Vote Tracker analysis shows NC county boards accepted 18,779 ballots through Oct 4 — a 19.3% drop from the same point in 2022. Democratic ballots are down 28.1% (45.7% of the total vs 51.3% in 2022), unaffiliated down 5.9% (37.9%), Republican ballots down 18.4% (16.2%, essentially flat share). Fewer absentee votes, not necessarily fewer votes overall — Democrats are returning to in-person voting, per the analysis. Single-sourced (underlying data: NC State Board of Elections Vote Tracker).
